reason: The official Ordnance Survey OS Open UPRN product is a materially different identifier-and-location source from the prior OS OpenMap–Local building-polygon window. It provides authoritative UPRNs and coordinate references for addressable locations and is free to use, but it is an addressable-location identifier dataset rather than a cadastral/title parcel polygon dataset. Therefore it cannot satisfy the canonical parcel geometry/bbox prerequisite for Height Difference. No target-specific canonical parcel binding exists in the verified lineage, so accepted/materialized/direct parcel counts remain zero and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
